reason: persistedAstOrTextFallback raises the typed StoredAstUnreadableError on a write or index path that has no usable text to stand in for an unreadable stored AST. Both callers already read corpus payloads inside a rejection boundary (the projection payload read's Result.tryPromise, EU completion's legacyOperation) that classifies a raised payload error as an unreadable payload, so the refusal takes the same typed path as any other payload read failure instead of being recorded as an empty document.
